_help: Fix the player pool by hand if Riot's data is wrong. Entries are Riot player ids, or 'CODE:handle' (e.g. 'T1:Faker'). 'include' forces a player into the draft pool, 'exclude' removes them. seed_adjust nudges the auto-pick rating, e.g. {"T1:Faker": 6}. Applies on the next roster sync (Actions > Sync rosters > Run workflow).
